digest.component_or_area: T5c security review criterion in plan-review gate
propositions: T5c security findings must be grounded in the current codebase and configuration via read tools, not evaluated purely as written per the shared preamble
Undeclared-access-posture findings must be capped at one per plan with additional surfaces folded into evidence rather than emitting multiple findings
Candidate findings citing neither a read repo artifact nor a quoted plan sentence must be demoted to minor severity, never suppressed
Only two HIGH-class finding types warrant severity >= major: plaintext secrets on boundary-crossing paths and undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces
T5c routing must shift from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.9 with corresponding updates to all pinned blocking-set test assertions
The rubric-text changes must preserve all existing trust-boundary scope phrases and pins tested by test_plan_review.py
